summary: Preserve legacy Tock slot booking while adding exact-time search rows, modern combobox and experience-card selection, trusted foreground checkout input, SMS opt-out handling, and typed redacted failures.
reason: Modern Tock venue pages can expose a time combobox and party-dependent experience cards without any per-time slot button, causing attach booking to fail before checkout. The SPA also requires foreground trusted input, can drop the first checkout transition, and may interpose an SMS opt-in dialog that must be declined.
validated_outcome: Fixture coverage exercises layout detection, exact combobox matching, party-size experience disambiguation, exact-time search rows, the SMS-decline portal, typed non-interactive CVC handling, and redacted selector fallback state.
